Visit, enjoy and satisfy
Dec 2023 • Family
It’s on weekday, my family and I visited the place to enjoy dinner. Warm and cozy restaurant with Japanese style and decor. Nice food and service. 
Must try: pancake, ramen soup and mushroom hotpot. The staff was friendly and gentle.

Highly recommend you to visit the museum. The associate was active and knowledgeable. She showed her hospitality and the respect to the Buddha statues. Have a big clap for the ideas and setup and arrangement of the owner. He puts a lot of effort to build up this great place. It helps young generation like us to be closer to our history and we respect our Buddhism.

Happy fasting day
Sep 2023 • Couples
Outstanding dish for both vegetarian and non-vegetarian diners. We are not vegetarians and only came across the restaurant by chance, but they made us completely ignore the salty dishes. We both ordered soups as appetizers, a Lion's Mane Soup and a Cypress Two Soup. Each soup is fresh and delicate. We had a few dishes including red fish rice rolls with spicy sauce which had a delicious and unique flavor just like the savory dish. The sashimi combo is amazing. The staff is very nice, quick service response. I will give them 5 stars for the quality of food and service. I will definitely come back many more times.

Great Vegan restaurant and Museum
Oct 2022 • Family
Bongensai- Phamnghiemtrai is a Buddhist cultural centre rather than a restaurant. They serve great Japanese Vegan dishes, and also Vietnamese vegan. I love the vegan Phở here alot. There is a Vietnamese Buddhist Museum on second floor, and also a Buddhist shop inside the building. You must try this place if you want to know more about Buddhist culture, especially Vietnamese Buddhism. They also have second place in Dist 1 with Mahayana Buddhist gallery and great TeaLounge
